description: This file contains a class S3EncryptionMultipartUploaderV2 that extends the MultipartUploader class to handle multipart uploads of encrypted objects to Amazon S3, including encryption logic and configuration handling. It encapsulates the execution of encrypted multipart uploads with support for various encryption strategies and hooks.

classes.name: S3EncryptionMultipartUploaderV2
classes.description: A class that manages multipart encryption uploads to S3, extending MultipartUploader and incorporating encryption, metadata handling, and configuration logic.

methods.description: Returns a deferred data preparation callback that encrypts the source data and adjusts parameters for upload.
